states.name: Initial Load
states.description: Scene loaded with robot, six atoms arranged in semicircle, target molecule displayed, all counters at zero
states.condition: !window.__3D_STATE__ || window.__3D_STATE__.modelLoaded === false || (window.__3D_STATE__.selectedHydrogen === 0 && window.__3D_STATE__.selectedOxygen === 0 && window.__3D_STATE__.selectedCarbon === 0 && window.__3D_STATE__.selectedNitrogen === 0 && window.__3D_STATE__.selectedSulfur === 0 && window.__3D_STATE__.selectedChlorine === 0 && !window.__3D_STATE__.validationAttempted)

states.name: Atoms Selected
states.description: User has clicked and selected multiple atoms, counters updated, atoms glowing and orbiting inward
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && (window.__3D_STATE__.selectedHydrogen + window.__3D_STATE__.selectedOxygen + window.__3D_STATE__.selectedCarbon + window.__3D_STATE__.selectedNitrogen + window.__3D_STATE__.selectedSulfur + window.__3D_STATE__.selectedChlorine > 0) && !window.__3D_STATE__.validationAttempted

states.name: Validation Attempted
states.description: User clicked Validate button, validation state recorded, feedback displayed

states.name: Stoichiometry Correct
states.description: Selected atoms match target formula exactly, validation passed

states.name: Parameters Adjusted
states.description: Temperature and pressure sliders adjusted to valid ranges for synthesis
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.validationAttempted === true && window.__3D_STATE__.temperature >= 200 && window.__3D_STATE__.temperature <= 2000 && window.__3D_STATE__.pressure >= 1 && window.__3D_STATE__.pressure <= 100 && !window.__3D_STATE__.synthesisComplete

states.name: Synthesis Complete
states.description: Synthesis triggered and completed successfully, molecule formed

states.name: Stable Final State
states.description: System stable with completed synthesis, all state values consistent

action.code: document.querySelectorAll('canvas')[0].dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: window.innerWidth/2 + 100, clientY: window.innerHeight/2, bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => document.querySelectorAll('canvas')[0].dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: window.innerWidth/2 - 100, clientY: window.innerHeight/2, bubbles: true})), 500);

checks.expr: window.__3D_STATE__.selectedHydrogen + window.__3D_STATE__.selectedOxygen + window.__3D_STATE__.selectedCarbon + window.__3D_STATE__.selectedNitrogen + window.__3D_STATE__.selectedSulfur + window.__3D_STATE__.selectedChlorine > 0

action.code: const target = window.__3D_STATE__.targetMolecule; const formulas = {H2O:[2,1,0,0,0,0],CO2:[0,2,1,0,0,0],NH3:[3,0,0,1,0,0],H2SO4:[2,4,0,0,1,0]}; const needed = formulas[target] || [2,1,0,0,0,0]; const clicks = [[100,0],[100,0],[-100,0],[150,50],[-150,50],[0,100]]; for(let i=0; i<6; i++) { setTimeout(() => { const canvas = document.querySelectorAll('canvas')[0]; canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: window.innerWidth/2 + clicks[i][0], clientY: window.innerHeight/2 + clicks[i][1], bubbles: true})); }, i*300); } setTimeout(() => { const validateBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('Validate')); if (validateBtn) validateBtn.click(); }, 2500);

postconditions: Correct atoms selected matching target formula

action.code: const tempSlider = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]')).find(s => s.max >= 2000); if (tempSlider) { tempSlider.value = 800; tempSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); } const pressSlider = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]')).find(s => s.max <= 100 && s !== tempSlider); if (pressSlider) { pressSlider.value = 50; pressSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }
